body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a critical Storybook issue where ~15 plugin component stories (kanban, timeline, charts, calendar, grid, etc.) were throwing `useSchemaContext must be used within a SchemaRendererProvider` errors. The fix implements a three-pronged approach: a global decorator in Storybook preview, console error detection in the test-runner, and comprehensive smoke tests.

**Changes:**
- Added a global `withSchemaProvider` decorator in Storybook that wraps all stories with `SchemaRendererProvider` (empty dataSource), while preserving the ability for stories to override with their own provider via React context nesting
- Enhanced test-runner with preVisit/postVisit hooks to collect and assert against critical console errors during story rendering
- Added 14 smoke tests covering provider requirement, SchemaRenderer integration, and all 9 plugin component types

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `.storybook/preview.ts` | Added global `withSchemaProvider` decorator wrapping all stories with `SchemaRendererProvider` to provide empty dataSource context |
| `.storybook/test-runner.cjs` | Added console error collection in preVisit and critical error assertion in postVisit to catch provider/React errors in CI |
| `packages/react/src/__tests__/SchemaRendererProvider.smoke.test.tsx` | New test file with 14 tests verifying useSchemaContext behavior, SchemaRenderer integration, and plugin component rendering |
